description: Ministry of Labour - Award made to the Industrial Dispute between D. M. P.  D. Perera and Ceylon German Technical Training Institute (E only)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of an industrial dispute award under the Industrial Disputes Act, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. It involves statutory procedures for dispute resolution, references to specific legal provisions (Section 4(1) and 18(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act), and the formal publication of a legal award. While it mentions government officials (Commissioner General of Labour, Minister of Labour), these references are incidental to the core legal/regulatory function of publishing the arbitration award and do not constitute government personnel or structural changes that would trigger Types 1-3 classification.
